import random, numpy as np
from portfolio_baseline import portfolio_risk_python, portfolio_return_python
from portfolio_optimized import portfolio_risk_c, portfolio_return_c

for n in [0, 1, 2, 10, 137]:
    random.seed(n)
    cov = [[0.0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n):
            cov[i][j] = cov[j][i] = random.random()*0.01 if i != j else 0.01+random.random()*0.04
    w = [random.random() for _ in range(n)]
    if n: w = [x/sum(w) for x in w]
    r = [random.random() for _ in range(n)]
    a = portfolio_risk_python(w, cov); b = portfolio_risk_c(w, cov)
    c = portfolio_return_python(w, r); d = portfolio_return_c(w, r)
    assert abs(a-b) < 1e-12, (n,a,b)
    assert abs(c-d) < 1e-12, (n,c,d)
    wa = np.array(w, dtype=np.float32)
    ca = np.array(cov, dtype=np.float64)
    ra = np.array(r, dtype=np.float64)
    assert abs(portfolio_risk_c(wa, ca) - a) < 1e-6
    assert abs(portfolio_return_c(wa, ra) - c) < 1e-5
    if n:
        big = np.zeros((n*2, n*2)); big[::2, ::2] = ca
        assert abs(portfolio_risk_c(np.repeat(wa, 2)[::2], big) - a) < 1e-6
print("extra correctness checks passed")
